statements.quote: Data Center revenue for the first quarter was a record $75.2 billion, up 92% from a year ago and up 21% sequentially, driven by the ramp of our Blackwell 300 products and demand for our InfiniBand, Spectrum-X™ Ethernet, and NVLink™ solutions.
statements.notes: Quarterly figure (Q1 FY27), not full-year; table in p01 gives $75,246 million.

statements.quote: Under the previous sub-markets, Data Center compute revenue was a record $60.4 billion, up 77% from a year ago and up 18% sequentially.
statements.notes: Q1 FY27 quarterly figure; a component of the $75.2 billion Data Center revenue, do not add to it.

statements.quote: Data Center networking revenue was a record $14.8 billion, up 199% from a year ago and up 35% sequentially.
statements.notes: Q1 FY27 quarterly figure; a component of the $75.2 billion Data Center revenue, do not add to it.

statements.quote: Hyperscale revenue increased sequentially and remained at approximately 50% of Data Center revenue, while the remaining 50% came from a continued diversification of customers, including AI Clouds, industrial, enterprise, and sovereign customers.
statements.notes: Share is of Data Center revenue, not of total revenue; Q1 FY27 quarter. Describes the customer mix within Data Center.

statements.quote: No shipments of Data Center Hopper products to China occurred during the quarter, compared with $4.6 billion in the first quarter of fiscal year 2026.
statements.notes: Prior-year Q1 FY26 Data Center Hopper shipments to China; a subset of Data Center revenue. Q1 FY27 figure was zero.
